Witness

“You just be a watcher, and the miracle of watching is meditation.” — Osho

A quiet place to sit, guided by six voices — Osho, Nāgārjuna, Bodhidharma, Ashtavakra, Kali, and Nisargadatta — each pointing at the same thing: you are not the mind. You are the one watching it. Sit with that watching long enough and even the witness can be let go — until what's left is simply, plainly, I am.
